verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a full incident-management API (create incidents, timeline, retrospectives) and a hosted MCP server that lets AI clients query incidents, on-call schedules, and 'take action' with a large set of write-enabled tools (135 write paths per runtime probe), which strongly implies end-to-end incident handling without a dashboard. However, no evidence explicitly names 'acknowledge', 'escalate', or 'resolve' as documented API/MCP actions, leaving the exact scope of automatable lifecycle actions unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit doc/example showing ack/escalate/resolve calls via API or MCP tool names, and independent confirmation of successful end-to-end agent-driven resolution.
